An effective focus method for reading is to find a quiet, comfortable spot with minimal distractions. Set a timer for 15-30 minutes and begin reading. When starting, take a couple of deep breaths to clear your mind and increase focus. To further maintain focus, set a small stimulating reward, such as a chocolate or a short phone break, after completing specific page goals or segments. This reward will not only motivate you to continue but also help boost concentration.
